title: CoreXTrader - Trading Terminal & Workspace with AI
excerpt: CoreXTrader is a trading terminal and workspace with built-in AI, its own scripting language (TDSL) and a backtesting engine. Traders connect cTrader, MetaTrader 5 and Binance accounts; brokers, prop firms and hedge funds can offer it under their own brand.
content_html:
Professional Trading Platform

CoreXTrader: Not Just Trading —
A Revolution in Market Intelligence

A comprehensive trading platform with custom strategy development, advanced analytics, and seamless market connectivity.

Works with your broker or prop firm

See setup guides · Broker or prop firm not listed? We build custom API integrations.

For business

Run your firm on CoreXTrader

Your brand on the terminal, our Brokerage Engine underneath, and an admin panel to see everything.

Book a demo

Enterprise Infrastructure

Terminal Architecture.

Complete trading development environment with Strategy IDE, TDSL language, AI integration, comprehensive backtesting, and professional trading tools.

Key Features:

  • Strategy IDE with TDSL Agent for AI-assisted coding
  • TDSL (Trading Domain Specific Language)
  • AI-powered market analysis with the Inspector
  • Advanced Strategy Tester with tick-level backtesting
  • 15 Global Languages with full native translations & RTL support
  • 4 Workspace Theme Modes (including high-contrast Light & Dark)
  • Professional charting with technical indicators
  • Account analytics: equity, drawdown and monthly returns
